name: image-studio
description: Generate and edit images in Claude Code with the Codex CLI on your ChatGPT plan: no API key, a live placeholder while it works, and the picture right in the chat

useWithoutAsking.title: Let Claude use it unasked
useWithoutAsking.description: When on, Claude may generate images on its own when a task needs one (a hero image, a sprite, an icon). When off, only when you ask.

reasoningEffort.title: Codex reasoning effort
reasoningEffort.description: How hard the Codex agent thinks before calling the image tool: low (fastest), minimal, medium or high. Image quality is unaffected.

outputDir.title: Output folder
outputDir.description: Where new images are saved when no path is given, relative to the session's working directory

timeoutMinutes.title: Timeout (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: How long one image may take before Codex is stopped

codexPath.title: Codex executable
codexPath.description: Full path to codex if it is not found automatically (leave empty to search PATH)

nodePath.title: Node executable
nodePath.description: Node 18+ used to run the bundled helper (leave as node to search PATH)
